issue.title: Evaluate source tree writer
issue.body:
In both v3 and v2 knowledge of how contents were being emitted leaks around too far for my liking. In almost all cases of writing you have a destination folder and want normal Java folder and file naming semantics inferred from package and class name.

The one potential exception to this rule is annotation processors which go through the `Filer`. I don't think we necessarily need to cover that use case, but if it can be done easily that would be a nice touch.

issue.title: Add throws clause to beginMethod
issue.body: I'd like to be able to add `throws SomeException` clauses to method declarations. I've been poking around and didn't see this functionality. Do you guys not do this at Square (you must be emiting control flows for exceptions)?

issue.title: Interface methods should not emit public, abstract
issue.body: Not quite sure the right approach to take with this. We can either propagate these implementation details downward into `Modifiable` or switch to private fields with public getters (e.g., `Set<Modifier> modifiers()`) which can be overridden to return subsets.

issue.title: StackOverflowError with generic types
issue.body:
There's a circle in `TypeName.get/list`, `ParameterizedTypeName.get` and `TypeVariableName.get`. The following test:

``` java
  private <E extends Enum<E>> E recursiveEnum(E[] values) {
    return values[0];
  }

  @Test public void genericTypes() throws Exception {
    Method recursiveEnum = getClass().getDeclaredMethod("recursiveEnum", Enum[].class);
    TypeName.get(recursiveEnum.getReturnType());
    TypeName.get(recursiveEnum.getGenericReturnType()); // StackOverflowError !!!
    TypeName.get(recursiveEnum.getParameterTypes()[0]);
    TypeName.get(recursiveEnum.getGenericParameterTypes()[0]); // StackOverflowError !!!
  }
```

issue.title: Hardcoded line separator bug
issue.body:
The bug occurs when the Javadoc text formed with Windows `\r\n` line separator.

For example, we have the comment `A\r\n\r\nB\r\n`. Because `JavaPoet` uses hardcoded line separator, `CodeWriter#emitAndIndent(String)` splits the comment on the next lines: `A\r`, `\r`, `B\r`. As the second line is not empty, indentation emitted.

It's a problem, if someone wants to test generation of Javadoc, that uses `JavaPoet`. Generated Javadoc depends on a platform (Windows or Unix). On Unix the Javadoc empty lines are really empty, but on Windows they are indented. In reason of this unreal to test generation of a Javadoc on different platforms.

Hardcoded line separator may cause and others bugs also.

issue.title: Add support for anonymous inner classes
Add trailing newline to methods if necessary
Imports sometimes incorrect when inheriting nested type of same name
Converting Specs to Builders
issue.body: Right now, you have to recreate the Builder from the spec manually, which is not easy for more complex things like `MethodSpec` and requires static utility functions for maintaining. A simple fix would be to add a new `*Spec.builder()` instance method that converts that Spec instance to the respective builder type.

issue.title: Documentation Support
issue.body:
Javadoc on type, field, method. Would be nice to have top-of-file command for license and/or generated warning as well. In its dumbest form this just need to take a string (or aggregate strings).

Interesting things here might be `@param` support on a `ParameterWriter` (`VariableWriter` subclass)? `@throws` on a `ThrowsWriter`? `@return` somewhere?
